label: Multiplication of a nature: shared nature, added difference, reception in matter
term: multiplication of a nature (Plurification: SharesNature, AddsDifference, InMatter)
definition: Plurification gives three primitive predicates for the multiplication inventory of De ente c.3 [69874] (Baur/Koch numbering; Leonine c.4). SharesNature x y: x and y are candidates of one shared nature, so that their being two would be a multiplication (plurificatio) of it. AddsDifference x: some difference is added to x's nature, as a genus is multiplied into species by differentiae. InMatter x: x's nature (form) is received in matter, as a species is multiplied into individuals by different matters. The third mode, one instance absolute and another received, is expressed with the existing EsseReceivedIn (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) applied to esse. The three predicates are constrained only by the readings that use them; no theory of genus, species, matter or individuation is built in, and SharesNature is not defined from essence equality.
